thesis: Reduce surface area by making existing INK, VOICE/LAB, REPLAY and LIVE surfaces share stronger material, temporal and addressed-course primitives rather than opening parallel apps.

deltas.behavior: Dragging paints one swept brush-contact ribbon with pressure/speed/tilt, coherent bristle lanes and paper tooth instead of a cloud of independently randomized dabs.
The existing scrolling spectrum carries target/heard pitch traces and borrowed-beat boundaries; bounded onset Δ and center-hold witnesses are shared by standalone VOICE and FIELD LAB PULSE.
deltas.authority: Practice evidence only; no microphone audio is stored and no singing-quality or health authority is claimed.

deltas.behavior: One fold-bloom-addressed-course/v0.1 primitive normalizes REPLAY cues and AUDIO MAP beat/phrase/section landmarks; REPLAY gets cue-by-cue STEP without a second timeline model.
deltas.authority: STEP changes address/playhead only; source evidence, authored operations and profile authority are unchanged.

deltas.behavior: Existing LIVE SOURCE drawer now contains one structural strip/minimap and FLOW/STEP transport: FLOW is ordinary real-time playback; STEP pauses source time and advances one addressed BEAT, PHRASE or SECTION; strip tap scrubs source position.
deltas.authority: AUDIO MAP remains source structure authority; authored FOLD/BLOOM/SPLIT/RETURN remain independent gameplay actions.

convergence: No new route was added for INK, VOICE training, REPLAY stepping, turn-based LIVE, or track minimap.
FIELD LAB stayed at seven unequal projections; VOICE deepened the existing PULSE projection instead of becoming an eighth.
REPLAY and LIVE share the same addressed-course grammar instead of separate stepping systems.
The LIVE minimap is a control projection of the existing AUDIO MAP, not a new visualizer authority.
remaining_lived_evidence: Real-phone tactile judgment of INK 0.4 against the former spray/dab feel.
Real-voice use of onset and center-hold witnesses across NOTE/CALL/SCALE/HUM.
Ordinary phone use of LIVE STEP at BEAT/PHRASE/SECTION grains on a full local track.
